decision: Required to start the Sprint from the pit lane.
fact: The rear wing specification has been changed while under Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Sprint from the pit lane.
reason: BWT Alpine F1 Team changed the rear wing assembly of Car 43 under Parc Ferme without the approval of the Technical Delegate, this not being in accordance with Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. The assembly is of a different specification, which is a breach of Article 40.9 and Car 43 is required to start the Sprint from pit lane in accordance with Article 40.9 b).
rules_referenced: Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 43 Changes Made During Parc Ferme
